summary: Master last-mile delivery and distribution strategy in 5 days with route planning, dispatch control, KPI dashboards, and POD workflows.
lede: Last-mile delivery and distribution strategy helps teams move from informal delivery management to a structured, measurable operating system. This course covers route assessment, dispatch controls, proof-of-delivery workflows, exception management, and performance reporting using practical operational tools. You will work with route maps, KPI scorecards, delivery exception logs, dashboard views, and digital tracking concepts to diagnose inefficiency and set practical service targets. The course also helps you develop a delivery diagnostics scorecard, a route optimization plan, and an actionable distribution improvement plan for environments with partial data, mixed fleet capacity, and outsourced carriers.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for you if you manage, analyze, or improve delivery execution in a distribution network where service timing, route control, and proof-of-delivery accuracy matter.
prerequisites: You should bring a working understanding of delivery or distribution operations, plus familiarity with basic KPI reporting. A laptop is recommended for hands-on exercises with spreadsheet templates and dashboard mock-ups, and prior exposure to route planning, fleet scheduling, or customer delivery workflows will help you get more from the applied sessions.
